base_scenario.label: base

recommendations.dissent_summary: Bull case: in a strong advance the underlying (IWM) typically out-totals a covered-call wrapper; high yield is not outperformance.

recommendations.rationale_en: We read Global X Russell 2000 Covered Call as a hold on the short horizon — composite score 51/100, 66% confidence. catalysts: Upcoming macro prints (CPI/PCE, jobs) and FOMC communication.

risks: Capped upside — lags the underlying in strong advances (opportunity cost).

recommendations.fundamental_summary: Covered-call/option-income ETF: distribution yield ~8.8%. Writes calls on IWM — trades upside for income; distribution is not total return and may include return of capital.
